title: Add owned ACP session executor lifecycle and asynchronous bounded v1 setup
goal: Vision: V-6. Provide session-isolated lifecycle and asynchronous setup for the coordinated actual ACP-supplied MCP bridge, preserving all legacy public executor implementations and wire behavior. This patch is integrated only with the concrete bridge, not published alone as a disconnected API.

reuse.searched: Existing AcpEngine SessionEntry, PreparedTurn, admission policy, session eviction/close; negotiated stdio scoped workers/cancellation/output ownership; official pinned ACP Stdio MCP descriptors; coordinated root session-MCP design.
reuse.reason: Add default trait hooks and per-session executor ownership using existing admission and cancellation, preserving legacy executor/HTTP APIs. No external imports or dependency additions.

limitations: Factory and close hooks must be cooperative; generic blocked readers/writers or noncooperative executors can delay scoped shutdown.
No complete ACP certification claim; concrete bridge implementation and integrated tests remain owned by parent and bridge worker.
Parent owns all pushes/external coordination; scoped local WIP commits only.

api_contract.types: AcpSessionSpec { cwd, mcp_servers, admission }; AcpMcpStdioServer { name, command, args, env }; AcpMcpEnvVar { name, value }
api_contract.lifecycle: Default nonblocking close_session hook; private per-session owner invokes it exactly once outside locks on rollback, eviction, explicit close, EOF/output failure; PreparedTurn retains executor Arc
api_contract.policy: Existing AcpAdmissionPolicy::policy() made public read-only; selected custom policy and subject retained
api_contract.compatibility: No required public AcpTurnContext or AcpAdmissionPolicy fields; existing executor implementations use default factory behavior; legacy sessions/HTTP serialization remain unchanged

validation.format: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed
validation.review: Independent review_gemi review: two capacity races repaired; final source review reports no remaining concrete blocker
coverage: Typed required descriptor validation, exact cwd/arguments/literal env and selected admission identity
Per-session executor routing, same-cwd isolation and connection-owned prompt/cancel confinement
Blocked setup leaves existing prompt cancellation readable; global pending admission bounded across connections in active-first and setup-first order
Pending reservation transfers atomically to pending-publication ownership; failures hold reservation through outside-lock rollback
EOF cancels setup, late executor returned after cancellation closes once with no session ID/output
Eviction and legacy explicit close invoke lifecycle once outside engine mutex; EOF preserves legacy/other-connection sessions
Failed setup-success response cleans both published and unpublished owned executors while input stays open
validation.existing_assertion_update: The earlier closed-output regression formerly read zero counters from retained C after EOF. Connection-owned v1 sessions now close/remove on output failure, so the test asserts C absence while preserving its deterministic gated reader, cancellation and no-executor-call assertions. No tests removed.

source_delta.note: Positive functionality/lifecycle addition. No test relocation, deleted capabilities, dependency change or reduction claim.

handoff.publication_constraint: Do not publish disconnected factory API alone; integrate with concrete bridge and actual supplied-MCP socket tests

integration_result: Coherent bridge and upstream Unix interop repair accepted and published together. Nine actual ACP CLI tests plus affected suites and final workspace check pass. This closes only the scoped component task; full ACP compliance and complete core below100k remain open.
